item.title: 🟠 Update now: 7-Zip fixes RCE flaw exploitable with malicious archives
item.description:
Why this matters: RCE vulnerability — patch immediately, check for exposed attack surface.
7-Zip version 26.02 was released to fix a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow attackers to execute malicious code by convincing users to open specially crafted compressed files. [...]

Source: BleepingComputer  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 10h ago
